_comment: Battle AI phase 4 (docs/battle-ai-design.md): player delegation. A custom 2-vs-1 scenario (not the default 5v5 line) so the delegated pair and the single enemy read clearly at this zoom. Box-selects both team-0 units, delegates them to AI subcommander group 5 (Ctrl+Shift+5) so they advance and engage the enemy on their own -- no further orders from the player -- then, with the same selection still active, issues an immediate Hold stance (Ctrl+H) to take manual control back, per the design doc's 'a manual player order to a delegated unit always overrides the subcommander's directive'. Driven live through the real SelectionManager by tools/demo/DemoInputRecorder.gd; world coordinates; physics ticks (60/s).
